title: The SCIM API, SDK and Terraform read surface in ZPA

prose.text: The SCIM read surface is split across two base paths.

endpoints.statement: The documented SCIM calls in ZPA are GETs: SCIM groups of an IdP and one group under /userconfig/v1/customers, an IdP's SCIM attribute headers and one header under /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers, and an attribute's values under /userconfig/v1/customers.

quotes: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /userconfig/v1/customers/{customerId}/scimgroup/idpId/{idpId}.
Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /userconfig/v1/customers/{customerId}/scimgroup/{scimGroupId}.
Send a GET request to the endpoint /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/idp/{idpId}/scimattribute in the scim-attribute-header-controller.
Send a GET request to the endpoint /userconfig/v1/customers/{customerId}/scimattribute/idpId/{idpId}/attributeId/{attributeId} in the scim-attribute-header-controller

spec-get-only.statement: The captured API specification has only get operations on its SCIM group, SCIM attribute and SCIM value paths, and no operation that creates, changes or deletes them.

paging.statement: The list calls page with page and pagesize; the default page size is 20 and the maximum is 500.

expect.description: Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

group-filters.statement: The SCIM group list can be filtered by startTime and endTime on modified_time, which must be set together, and sorted by id, name, creationTime or modifiedTime, defaulting to modifiedTime.

expect.description: The start of a time range for requesting last updated data (modified_time) for the SCIM group. This requires setting the endTime parameter as well.
Specifies the field name to sort the results. Supported Sort fields are (id,name,creationTime,modifiedTime).If not provided, results are sorted by modifiedTime

group-fields.statement: A SCIM group has id, name, idpId, idpGroupId, internalId, creationTime and modifiedTime, with name, idpId and idpGroupId required; the Zscaler id is an integer while idpGroupId is the IdP's own string identifier.

attribute-header-fields.statement: A SCIM attribute header has name, idpId, dataType, schemaURI, multivalued, required, caseSensitive, mutability, returned, uniqueness and canonicalValues, with dataType, mutability, name and returned required.

python-methods.statement: The Python SDK exposes SCIMGroupsAPI with list_scim_groups(idp_id, query_params) and get_scim_group(group_id, query_params), and ScimAttributeHeaderAPI with list_scim_attributes, get_scim_attribute and get_scim_values, each taking the IdP ID.

zpa-64-internal-id.title: What a SCIM group's internal ID is
zpa-64-internal-id.detail: The SCIM Groups page lists an Internal Group ID as 'The internal ID for the group', and the API help example shows internalId equal to id as a string. No source says how it relates to id and idpGroupId beyond that, or whether policy ever uses it.
